hot.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
hot.why_hot_now: Shattered Avengers: Endgame's all-time opening weekend record with $360M domestic and is already at $1.67B globally in only its third week.
hot.typical_scene: sleek new suit swinging between sunlit skyscrapers at golden hour

hot.name: Tom Holland
hot.why_hot_now: Star of the biggest box-office opening in history, plus his secret marriage to Zendaya was confirmed at the London premiere this month.
hot.typical_scene: matching spider brooches on the red carpet, arm around Zendaya

hot.name: Zendaya
hot.why_hot_now: Confirmed married to Tom Holland while simultaneously starring in two different billion-dollar films — Spider-Man and Nolan's The Odyssey.
hot.typical_scene: crystal-encrusted couture gown, laughing off a fan's marriage proposal on the red carpet

hot.name: Ariana Grande
hot.why_hot_now: Playing the final Eternal Sunshine Tour dates this week after dropping album Petal on July 31, triggering a massive chair-choreo TikTok wave.
hot.typical_scene: seated on a clear acrylic chair, mid-performance, soft pink stage lighting

hot.name: Jaafar Jackson
hot.why_hot_now: The billion-dollar Michael Jackson biopic Michael landed on Starz on August 10 and his uncanny performance is flooding social media with reaction videos.
hot.typical_scene: mid-moonwalk in a sequined red jacket, eerily mirroring the King of Pop

hot.name: Matt Damon
hot.why_hot_now: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey, with Damon as Odysseus, crossed $1 billion at the box office this week in its fourth week of release.
hot.typical_scene: battle-worn and salt-bearded, gripping an oar on a storm-tossed Greek ship

hot.name: Jeremy Allen White

hot.typical_scene: white chef's coat, sweat-drenched, thousand-yard stare mid-dinner-service

hot.name: Ayo Edebiri
hot.why_hot_now: Snagged an Emmy nomination for The Bear the same week her costar Jeremy Allen White was left out, making her the Bear's sole acting nominee.
hot.typical_scene: chef's apron, eyes wide, caught between panic and composure in a tight kitchen

hot.name: Sabrina Carpenter
hot.why_hot_now: Her new album Man's Best Friend drops August 29 and the lead single is dominating radio and pre-save charts this week.
hot.typical_scene: retro-glam close-up, bubblegum pink lip, finger-gunning straight at the camera
